description: This file provides a utility function `formatRelativeTime` for converting an epoch timestamp into a human-friendly relative time string. It is designed to be used in the frontend code of a simple notes application, specifically for displaying time information.

methods.name: formatRelativeTime(epochMs)
methods.description: Converts an epoch timestamp (in milliseconds) into a human-readable relative time string such as 'just now', '5m ago', or a localized date string if older than a week.
